description: Changes: gives the named rooms to one housekeeper on that day's roster for a date, or takes rooms off when unassign is true (only rooms not yet cleaned). No preview: the change is made when called. Gives rooms to a housekeeper for a day, as PMS › Housekeeping › Assign rooms does: the name must be on that day's housekeeping roster. unassign true takes the rooms off whoever has them, only while still assigned (a cleaned or inspected room keeps its stamp). date defaults to today at the hotel. One of the two people the owner named. Needs the owner's sign-in.

date.description: Work date YYYY-MM-DD (today at the hotel when not sent)

housekeeper.description: A name on that day's housekeeping roster

unassign.description: true to take the rooms off instead

name: assign_housekeeping
title: Give rooms to a housekeeper
